summary: E2E test of SahaCep (backend + frontend). Backend: 22/22 pytest pass, covering /me, company, customers CRUD, isolation (409 without a company, 404 across companies), jobs CRUD, filters aktif/tamamlandi and scope=today, status patch, complete, payment patch, free-plan 402 on the 16th job, invite 402 on free and 200 on pro, staff auto-join via /me, staff sees only assigned jobs, staff gets 403 on customers/receivables/POST jobs, photo multipart upload once/sonra, /files with auth (401 without, 404 cross-company), public form 404 until the job is completed, public photo endpoint, dashboard numbers, Stripe checkout URL plus pending status. Frontend: landing (Turkish), ticket sign-in, onboarding, dashboard, new job, job detail status buttons, photo upload, complete panel, share panel with WhatsApp link, public service form at 390px with photos and the invalid-token state, receivables mark paid, jobs table filters and search, customers, team invite (pro), company settings, billing redirect to checkout.stripe.com, mobile bottom nav (owner 5 items, staff 2 items), staff mobile flow (assigned job only, no edit/delete, complete with kart), refresh keeps session, sign-out goes to /sign-in. One real UI bug: a customer created with the '+ Yeni' dialog in the job form is not selected.

minor.issue: jobs_this_month counts the jobs that exist now (count_documents on created_month). An owner can delete jobs to get free quota back and so bypass the 15/month limit. Use a per-month counter on the company doc that only goes up.
If the Clerk API fails, requests.raise_for_status bubbles up as a generic 500. Catch it and return 503 with a Turkish message. Do not fall back to a default role.
Unauthenticated. Low risk, since the session id is needed and the call is idempotent, but consider requiring auth plus company match.

ui_bugs.issue: After the dialog creates a customer, the address autofills but the Select shows the 'Müşteri seçin' placeholder. form.customer_id is reset to '', so pressing 'İşi oluştur' shows the toast 'Müşteri seçin' and no POST /api/jobs is sent. RCA: Radix Select gets value=c.id in the same render that the new SelectItem is added. Radix's hidden native select/onValueChange then sends '' to pickCustomer, which overwrites customer_id. Fix: in pickCustomer add `if (!cid) return;`, or set customer_id in a later tick / after the customers state updates. Picking the customer by hand afterwards works.

issues: Fade-in ('rise') animation makes content look faded for about 1s on load. Cosmetic only.

update_customer returns find_one({'id': cid}) without the company scope. It is safe after matched_count, but keep queries consistent
Pytest must run with `-n 0` (pytest.ini enables xdist); the tests are sequential/stateful

rca of the issue: JobForm dialog bug: CustomerDialog.onSaved sets customers=[...l, c] and customer_id=c.id together. Radix Select fires onValueChange('') (from its hidden native select, whose options do not include the new value yet), and pickCustomer('') overwrites customer_id while address keeps c.address. Repro: /app/isler/yeni -> '+ Yeni' -> fill name -> Kaydet -> select shows placeholder -> 'İşi oluştur' -> toast 'Müşteri seçin'. Mitigation: ignore empty values in pickCustomer.
